findings.evidence: "A good title names the area, the failing behavior and the trigger" explains standard bug-report writing already demonstrated by the base template. This adds little knowledge compared with the skill's specific reproduction, waiver and environment rules.
findings.fix: Remove this explanatory paragraph while retaining the concrete title format in the base template; keep the reference focused on the non-obvious evidence, severity and priority rules.

findings.evidence: The visual section is guarded by `if [ "$TEST_TYPE" = "UI/Visual" ] && [ -n "$FIGMA_URL" ]; then`. Following the flag-mode branch with `--type 'ui' --visual 'Button spacing and focus state'` but no --figma reaches successful creation while silently discarding the supplied visual checks. Supplying --figma or --visual for a regression case also discards those values.
findings.fix: Preserve supplied visual checks even when the Figma URL is unavailable, writing the design reference as Unknown and listing it under Open Questions. For non-UI cases, either retain supplied design context in the output or reject unsupported flag combinations with exit 2 instead of silently dropping them.
